learning_objectives.en: Read technical explanations and complete diagrams.

passages.title: R-C
passages.text: Before computers were common, people used typewriters. Pressing a key lifted a type bar with a letter and hit an inked ribbon to print on paper. At the end of a line, the carriage reached a bell and the writer used the carriage return lever to move the paper and begin a new line.

questions.prompt_vi: On a typewriter, pressing a key lifts a type ___.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài đọc cho đáp án bar.

questions.prompt_vi: The letter is printed through an inked ___.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài đọc cho đáp án ribbon.

questions.prompt_en: At the end of a line, you hear a ___.
questions.prompt_vi: At the end of a line, you hear a ___.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài đọc cho đáp án bell.

questions.prompt_en: The carriage return ___ moves the paper and starts a new line.
questions.prompt_vi: The carriage return ___ moves the paper and starts a new line.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài đọc cho đáp án lever.
